fix(text): cellLength, truncate and align count a tab as the cells render draws (rich-text-d0gz) (#307)

* fix(text): cellLength, truncate and align count a tab as the cells render draws (rich-text-d0gz)

cellLength measured the raw string, so a tab was 0 cells while render widened
it to its stop: truncate(6) left "ab\tcd" (10 cells drawn) untouched, and
align padded to the wrong width. cellLength now measures the expanded text,
and truncate and align widen tabs first, so the width they size to is the
width drawn. A deliberate departure from Rich's Text.cell_len.

* fix(text): truncate and align leave a text they do not change untouched; cellLength says what it measures (rich-text-d0gz)

Review (high): expanding tabs before the early return rewrote a text that fit,
fixing its stops at its own column 0 so it drew wrong after a prefix. Expansion
now happens only on the path that cuts or pads. errorLine's tab rationale
restated for the reason that survives the fix.
